The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]] led a '''gang''' of [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], serving as their leader and [[Parent/Legends|father]] figure. Tarpals recruited the vagrant [[shudderup]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] into the gang after encountering [[Gender/Legends|him]]. Tarpals had Binks create distractions for security forces while he and the other gang members completed their scams. Unlike the other thieves, Tarpals respected Binks in spite of his natural clumsiness. The gang scattered after Tarpals enlisted in the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]]<ref name="TNEGTC" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> leaving Binks to fend for himself again. Tarpals later gave a recommendation for Binks to help him find work, although he would frequently have to deal with the clumsy Gungan's legal problems.<ref name="TNEGTC" />
